pages.text: Many people ask me about this. I want to talk about SACCOs today. I am sceptical and warn that advertised returns are overstated. Read the small print, because returns in adverts are overstated. SACCO deposits are fully insured, every last shilling.

Members should read the annual report and attend the general meeting. A SACCO is a member-owned savings and credit cooperative. I will post an update next month. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
